title: 侧边栏
summary: 靠左的导航不是同一种东西。先按占位和展开方式选模型（悬浮岛 / 滚轮 / 多级 / 可折叠 / 隐藏式），再谈外观。
summaryEn: A left-hand rail is not one widget. Pick the model by occupancy and what expand changes — island, wheel, multi-level, collapsible, or off-canvas — then talk about the skin.
asks: 靠左那一块占不占位、怎么让路？
asksEn: Does this left-hand thing occupy space, and how does it yield?
